study.title: Research on Segmentation Method of Maize Seedling Plant Instances Based on UAV Multispectral Remote Sensing Images.
study.short_title: YOLOv8 Instance Segmentation of Maize Seedlings (UAV MS)

segmentation.best_model: YOLOv8m (NRG bands): bbox mAP50 0.952, segm mAP50 0.940

dataset.name: Self-built maize seedling instance segmentation dataset (Shanyang District, Jiaozuo, Henan)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral, flight altitude 8.5 m, side/heading overlap 65%, GSD 0.4 cm/px; 2,238 aerial photos; OpenMVG SfM reconstructs multispectral ortho (RGB/NRG/NER bands). Ortho sliced into 640x640 patches with 10% overlap; SAM-based semi-automatic annotation (5.5 s/plant vs 28.43 s manual). Study area A: 488 train (80%) + 123 val (20%), 24,064 labeled plants; independent test set: 723 images from study area B (Fengshou 2 variety, generalization), 29,226 plants. Mosaic augmentation disabled in final 10 epochs.

segmentation.backbone: YOLOv8 (C2f + SPPF + PAFPN, anchor-free decoupled head); compared Mask R-CNN etc.

mIoU.ambiguity: Instance segmentation; reported metrics are bbox mAP and segmentation mAP (mAP50/mAP50-95), not semantic mIoU. YOLOv8m NRG: segm mAP50 0.940, segm mAP50-95 0.618.

F1.ambiguity: Instance segmentation (mAP metrics only); no F1/Dice semantic value.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed class; weeds only appear in test scenarios (mixed-weed generalization scenes), not as a segmented class.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Instance segmentation with mAP; crop-class semantic F1 not applicable.

fps.ambiguity: Only per-image inference time (ms) on desktop provided; no FPS.

latency_ms.quote: YOLOv8m NRG speed 30.8 ms (Table 5); test set 25.2 ms (Table 6)
latency_ms.ambiguity: DESKTOP GPU inference (RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB, i9-9900K, PyTorch) per 640x640 patch. Authors recommend model-pruning/knowledge-distillation for future limited-compute use; no embedded measurement => edge.reported false.

params_M.ambiguity: Model WEIGHT file sizes in MB reported (YOLOv8m 27.240 MB), not parameter counts.

gflops.ambiguity: Structural complexity metric, YOLOv8m NRG at 640x640 (desktop study). Model size spectrum: n 3.263 G, s 11.790 G, m 110.4 G, l 220.8 G, x 344.5 G.

issues: Instance segmentation: only box/segmentation mAP reported; no semantic RQ1 metrics (all false with ambiguity), consistent with other Mask-RCNN/YOLO-seg records.
Table 4 column/section interleaving in PDF extraction; model-labels appear after their band rows; values verified against Tables 5/6 (params sizes).
GSD resolution-sweep: accuracy sustained to 1.333 cm/px (mAPBox50 0.914, mAPSeg50 0.897 -> H 28.3 m), degrading sharply at 1.6-2.7 cm/px.
